title: US tech stocks fall sharply as Nvidia turmoil and AI worries weigh on Wall Street
caption:
US stocks fell sharply on Monday, with the Nasdaq down 2.5% and the S&P 500 down 1.9%, led by technology companies. Nvidia shares fell 4.1% as the chipmaker deals with the resignation of chief executive Jensen Huang, and new US rules restrict remote access to advanced chips. Nvidia reports its quarterly results after the US market closes on Tuesday.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
